Recover the Past#002.src: Well. Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant- not quite the response I was looking for... a shame, too- I truly believe we were on to something.
Recover the Past#002.dst: Bien. Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayuda- ¿sabes qué? Te llamaré mi ayudante- no es la reacción que esperaba... una lástima, además- de verdad creía que íbamos por buen camino.

Recover the Past#003.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#003.dst: ...él no lo sabe. Tendrás que darle la noticia.

Recover the Past#004.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#004.dst: Hmpf. Quizá solo necesite más potencia... Si aumento el maná que puedo verter en el hechizo, entonces-

Recover the Past#005.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#005.dst: Mientras tanto, sin nuestro sujeto, habrá que apañarse con otro. Hoy está de guardia el explorador Reynauld, también originario de Fruma, igual que tú.

Recover the Past#007.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#007.dst: Desconcertante, sin duda... ojalá pudiéramos ver más allá. Me pongo a trabajar ya- ¡debemos saber más!

Recover the Past#008.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#008.dst: Teclas de movimiento para ver la jugada; Saltar para confirmar.

Recover the Past#009.dst: Habla con el Dr. Picard en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#010.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#010.dst: ¡Éxito! ¡Éxito, éxito, ÉXITO! ¡Soy un genio, el hombre más listo del mundo!
Recover the Past#010.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#011.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#011.dst: ¡Eh, tú, transeúnte cualquiera! ¡Has presenciado un prodigio mágico! ¡Acabo de restaurar mis recuerdos de hace años!
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#012.dst: Pareces de Fruma, ¿verdad? Entonces sabes tan bien como yo que tus recuerdos de tu vida anterior se han esfumado. Puf. ¡Ya no están!
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#013.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#013.dst: ¡Pero con este aparato... podemos cambiarlo! ¡Recuperar lo perdido! Recuperar el... ya me entiendes.
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#014.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#014.dst: Ahora bien, necesito sujetos de prueba... Tú servirías, sí, pero debo asegurarme de que esto funciona.
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#015.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#015.dst: ¡Escucha! Tengo una propuesta. Quieres recuperar tus recuerdos, ¿no? ¡Tráeme suficientes sujetos y te enseñaré lo que has perdido!
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#016.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#016.dst: Veamos, veamos... Necesitamos gente originaria de Fruma. Por aquí hay unos cuantos.
Recover the Past#016.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#017.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#017.dst: Puedes empezar por Caid, el aspirante a marinero. Lo encontrarás pasado {p}- sigue el camino hasta llegar al río.
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#018.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#018.dst: Mientras, yo seguiré haciendo ajustes aquí... Aún no es perfecto. Todavía me faltan grandes trozos de memoria... ¿Hm? ¿Sigues aquí? ¡En marcha!
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#019.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#019.dst: Encuentra al marinero Caid junto a su barca en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#020.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#020.dst: ¿Y bien? Te he dado una tarea, ¿qué haces aquí todavía? Ve a buscar al marinero Caid. Lo encontrarás pasado {p}, sigue el camino hasta el río.
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#021.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#021.dst: ¿Eh? ¡Oh! Yo, eh, ¡aquí no hay nada que ver! Solo... ¡solo le echaba un vistazo a mi viejo barco!
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#022.dst: ¿Te envía Picard? ¿El tipo encerrado en la torre? Vaya. Me alegra saber que por fin ha terminado. ¿Pero para qué me quiere a mí?
Recover the Past#022.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#023.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#023.dst: ... ¿Mirar mis recuerdos de Fruma, eh? No lo tengo tan claro. Si no están, por algo será. ¡Yo-yo estoy bien aquí! No necesito saber nada de...
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#024.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#024.dst: ... Sí, vale. Iré contigo a que me revisen la memoria. Pero hazme un favor antes, ¿vale?
Recover the Past#024.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#025.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#025.dst: Se me da bien construir. Pensé en probar a hacer un barco y, ¡aquí está! Está bien, ¿eh?
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#026.dst: ¡De eso hablo, toma esa, Reynauld! ¡Sabía que le gustaría a alguien!
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#028.dst: ¡Eh! Je, bueno, no te falta razón. Lo monté sobre todo con chatarra que encontré por ahí. Aun así, para ser un montón de desechos impresiona, ¿no?
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#029.dst: Tienes que prometerme que no se lo dirás a Reynauld pero... Algunas piezas más exóticas salieron del cuartel de los guardias. ¡Nada gordo! Solo cosillas de la superficie...
Recover the Past#029.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#030.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#030.dst: Solo me falta una pieza para terminarlo y, verás... Acaba de llegar un cargamento a la herrería... ¿Ves por dónde voy?
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#031.dst: Consígueme la pieza de la herrería y me iré contigo a la torre de Picard. No puedo dejar a mi criatura sin terminar así, ¿no?
Recover the Past#031.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#032.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#032.dst: Roba la caja de la casa del herrero en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#033.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#033.dst: ¿Ya tienes la caja? Está en la herrería, a un paso de aquí, en {p}. ¡Eso sí, que no te vean!
Recover the Past#033.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#034.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#034.dst: Lleva el paquete a Caid en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#035.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#035.dst: ... ¡Has vuelto! ¿Qué tal ha ido? Venga, dame el botín.
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#036.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#036.dst: El herrero no vio nada, ¿verdad? Me preocupa un poco que Reynauld me esté siguiendo la pista...
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#037.dst: ¡Ah, qué más da! ¡Por fin voy a terminar mi vieja barca!
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#038.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#039.dst: ¡Exacto! Todo barco que se precie tiene que llevar campana. Sin ella no sería lo mismo.
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#040.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#040.dst: ¡Vaya humos! Todo barco que se precie lleva campana, ¿sabes? ¿Crees que el Seaskipper se dejaría ver sin una? ¡Ya me parecía!
Recover the Past#040.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#041.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#041.dst: En fin... Supongo que has cumplido tu parte del trato, ¡así que no me queda otra que cumplir la mía!
Recover the Past#041.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#042.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#042.dst: ¡Guíame a la torre de Picard! A ver qué se esconde en este cabezón mío.
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#043.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#043.dst: Lleva a Caid ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#045.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#045.dst: ¡Ajá! ¡Habéis vuelto! Bien, bien, buena prueba para mis ajustes...
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#046.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#046.dst: ... Ya. ¿Y a este doctor le confiamos mis recuerdos?
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#047.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#047.dst: Vamos, vamos, no subestimes mi genio. ¡Estarás bien! Seguramente. Yo diría un noventa y cinco, bueno, noventa por ciento. Venga, súbete aquí.
Recover the Past#047.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#048.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#048.dst: Vale... Confío en que sepa lo que hace, doctor...
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#049.dst: Y ahora, solo tengo que... Activar el hechizo aquí, accionar la palanca allí, y...
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#051.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#051.dst: Bien, veamos qué tenemos aquí... Edwin, ¿puedes mirar esa otra caja de ahí?
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#052.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#052.dst: Claro. Oye, Caid. ¿Cómo consigues siempre estas cosas? Ahí dentro hay piezas caras, y no parecen de tu presupuesto.
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#053.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#053.dst: Bueno... Digamos que el último paquete de suministros de los guardias pesa un poco menos de lo que debería.
Recover the Past#053.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#054.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#054.dst: ¿Qué? Caid, dime que no has estado robando a los guardias. Sabes que no van a
Recover the Past#054.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#055.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#055.dst: Edwin, relájate. Solo les quito un poquito de la superficie. No van a notar uno o dos paquetes de treinta.
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#056.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#056.dst: Además, no les tengo miedo. Están aquí para protegernos, ¿no? Supongo que me soltarán con un aviso, como todas las otras veces.
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#057.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#057.dst: Si... si tú lo dices. Supongo que tienes razón. Tampoco necesitan tantos suministros. ¡Y nosotros les damos mejor uso que ellos!
Recover the Past#057.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#058.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#058.dst: ¡Exacto! Me alegra que estés de acuerdo. Entonces, ¿has encontrado algo bue
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#059.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#061.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#061.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#062.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#062.dst: Ya basta de ti. Vosotros dos, dad caza al cómplice.
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#065.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#065.dst: Caid, quedas detenido por reiterados robos de propiedad imperial.
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#066.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#066.dst: Tu expediente muestra que recibiste varios avisos por actos anteriores. Esta era tu última oportunidad y la has desperdiciado por completo.
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#067.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#067.dst: Llevadlo a prisión para seguir interrogándolo y decidid qué se hará con él.
Recover the Past#067.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#068.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#068.dst: ¡Eh! ¿Hola? ¡Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayudante! Sal de ese trance, tenemos que hablar.
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#069.dst: Hm. Hm hm hm. El recuerdo se ha cortado ahí... Me pregunto qué veríamos si
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#071.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#071.dst: Sí, eso parece... Pero quizá, si logro aumentar la potencia, entonces... ¡Sí! Soy un geni
Recover the Past#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#072.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#072.dst: ¿Eso es todo lo que soy? Un ladrón... ¿Solo sirvo para eso?
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#075.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#075.dst: ¡Ah! Transeúnte-convertido-en-ayuda- ¿sabes qué? Te llamaré mi ayudante. Veo que por fin has salido del trance.
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#076.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#076.dst: ¡Pero eso ahora no importa! ¡Lo que sí importa es lo que acabamos de ver! ¡Recuerdos revividos con todo detalle! ¡Este aparato cambiará el mundo!
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#077.dst: ... Aunque debo decirlo. Me pierdo un poco con la cronología. A Caid lo detuvieron- ¿cómo acabó entonces aquí, en Wynn, como soldado?
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#078.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#078.dst: ¡Necesitamos más sujetos si queremos averiguar la verdad! Hoy está de guardia el explorador Reynauld, también originario de Fruma, igual que tú.
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#079.dst: Sí, hm. Lo encontrarás cerca del puente hacia {p}. Cuento contigo para convencerlo de unirse a nuestro experimento. ¡En nombre de la ciencia!
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#080.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#080.dst: Encuentra al explorador Reynauld cerca del puente hacia {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#081.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#081.dst: Hm... ¿Dónde está esa barrera? ¿Esta magia no basta para atravesarla? Quizá si aumento la potencia, entonces...
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#082.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#082.dst: ¡Ah! ¡Ayudante! ¿Qué haces aquí? ¿Ya has hablado con el explorador Reynauld? Lo encontrarás cerca del puente hacia {p}.
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#084.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#084.dst: Ah, hola. ¿Qué ocurre? Parece que quieres algo de mí.
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#085.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#085.dst: ¿Hm? ¿El doctor raro quiere verme? ¿Para restaurar mis recuerdos? No diría que me fío mucho de ese hombre... pero me pica la curiosidad.
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#086.dst: Por desgracia, debo declinar. No puedo dejar mi puesto sin vigilancia. ¿Y si llegara un ataque corrupto? {p} se quedaría sin defensa.
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#087.dst: Hm, bueno. Si es solo un rato, quizá pueda funcionar. Siempre que prometas ayudar si de verdad hay un ataque.
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#088.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#088.dst: Entonces decidido. Iré contigo a ver al doctor. Pero primero necesitamos a alguien que vigile. ¿Tienes a alguien en mente?
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#089.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do, I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#089.dst: ¿Caid? Ese... granuja. Ha estado robando suministros, lo sé. Solo que no puedo probarlo. Pero si crees que servirá, seguro que va bien.
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#090.src: Yes, fine, I understand you've taken issue with my methodology. But it works! This has worked thrice now!
Recover the Past#090.dst: Sí, sí, entiendo que te moleste mi metodología. ¡Pero funciona! ¡Ya ha funcionado tres veces!

Recover the Past#091.src: Sigh... all of that, and we still weren't able to see what comes next! I swear, I was able to see more when I looked at my own memories! It's ridicu-
Recover the Past#091.dst: Ay... ¡tanto lío y seguimos sin ver lo que viene después! ¡Te juro que vi más cuando miré mis propios recuerdos! Es ridícu-

Recover the Past#092.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#092.dst: Lo vi hace poco yendo hacia el templo. Quizá haya cambiado de idea. Guíame hasta Caid, voy justo detrás de ti.
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#094.dst: Quizá Caid haya cambiado de idea. Guíame hasta él, voy justo detrás de ti.
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#095.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#095.dst: Convence a Caid de vigilar el puente en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#096.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#096.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#097.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#097.dst: Somos nosotros, y queremos pedirte algo. Nuestro amigo común intenta reclutarme para una especie de experimento.
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#098.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#098.dst: Solo que, si participo, {p} quedaría sin defensa. Así que te preguntamos si estarías dispuesto a vigilar mientras yo estoy ocupado.
Recover the Past#098.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#099.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#100.dst: No me malinterpretes, preferiría no dejar la seguridad de {p} en manos de un ladró... de alguien como tú. No eras mi primera opción, ni la segunda, ni la tercera
Recover the Past#100.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#103.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#103.dst: ¿Sí? Vaya, más fácil de lo que esperaba. Recuerda: si ves cualquier señal de ataque inminente, corre a la torre del doctor y avísanos al momento. La pelea, para los profesionales.
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#104.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#104.dst: ¡Ni se me ocurriría otra cosa! Pero piensa, Reynauld, que quizá el pasado se olvide por algo.
Recover the Past#104.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#105.dst: Bueno, supongo que asunto resuelto. Corramos a ver al doctor. No quiero dejar la seguridad de {p} en los dedos pegajosos de ese hombre más tiempo del necesario.
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#106.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#106.dst: Gracias por vuestra ayuda, Tasim y {u}. Y a Caid también...

Recover the Past#107.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#107.dst: Lleva a Reynauld ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#108.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#108.dst: Corramos a ver al doctor, no quiero dejar la seguridad de {p} en los dedos pegajosos de ese hombre más tiempo del necesario.
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#110.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#110.dst: ¡Ah, ayudante! ¡Bienvenido de vuelta, y veo que traes a nuestro próximo sujeto! ¡Maravilloso!
Recover the Past#110.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#112.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#112.dst: Vamos, vamos, da un paso al frente. ¡No seas tímido! ¡Ponte justo aquí! Mira directamente a la esfera y concéntrate en recordar.
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#114.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#114.dst: ¡Sí, sí! Tranquilo, el aparato se ha probado a fondo con Caid. Rapidito, solo tengo que activar esto... lanzar un hechizo aquí... y...
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#116.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#116.dst: ¿E-eh? Oye, ¿quién anda ahí? ¿Por qué llamas a estas hora
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#119.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#119.dst: N-no, claro que no- Eh. ¡Habría estado bien que, ya sabes, me avisaras de que venías!
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#120.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#120.dst: Sabes que esto no funciona así. Bueno, ¿dónde está la mercancía?
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#121.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#121.dst: Ya... siempre directo al grano contigo. Nunca un oh, ¿qué tal la semana? Siempre solo-...
Recover the Past#121.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#123.dst: Rescaté unas piezas de... eh, una de las fábricas cercanas. Espero que sea... seguramente sea lo que necesitas.
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#124.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#124.dst: ... Hm. ¿De una de las fábricas, dices? ¿Y seguro que no te vieron hacerlo? Si me pillaran hablando con un criminal conocido, ya sabes las consecuencias para los dos.
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#125.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#125.dst: N-no. No me vieron. Yo, eh... tomé precauciones. Entré de noche. Ya sabes.
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#127.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#127.dst: A-así que... ¿es suficiente? Te he traído lo que pediste.
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#128.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#128.dst: Bueno... eso sí, sí. Pero, Caid, sabes el riesgo que corro cada vez que vengo hasta aquí a hablar contigo. Necesitaré más que el mínimo para garantizar tu seguridad.
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#129.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#129.dst: Yo hmpf. Vale, vale, te- te añado unas esmeraldas. Para endulzar el trato.
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#130.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#130.dst: Excelente. Un placer hacer negocios, como siempre. Volveré en unas semanas.
Recover the Past#130.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#132.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#132.dst: Ah, Reynauld. Me alegra verte. Pasa, pasa.
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#133.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#133.dst: ¿Puedo preguntar a qué se debe esta reunión, señor?
Recover the Past#133.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#134.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#134.dst: Oh, nada especial. Solo quería charlar un momento sobre tu desempeño.
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#135.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#135.dst: Entiendes que quienes servimos a Su Majestad en puestos tan respetados debemos seguir un... estricto código de honor, ¿verdad?
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#136.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#136.dst: Si no, ¿cómo estaríamos seguros de que nuestras filas están limpias de faltas? Debemos dar ejemplo al pueblo de nuestra gran provincia.
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#137.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#137.dst: Y bien, ¿qué crees que pasaría si uno de los nuestros llegara a... doblar o romper ese código de honor? ¿Qué precedente sentaría eso?
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#139.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#139.dst: No es con placer que te informo de que tú, Reynauld, serás despojado de tu rango y detenido bajo cargos de deshonra y conspiración contra Su Majestad.
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#140.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#140.dst: A tu cómplice, el proveedor, lo atraparon el otro día. Me dicen que apenas dudó antes de decidirse a contar todos tus secretos.
Recover the Past#140.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#141.src: There is no place for your sort in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#141.dst: No hay lugar para los de tu clase en nuestras filas, Reynauld. Una lástima que se llegara a esto.
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#142.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#142.dst: No tienes lugar en nuestras filas, Reynauld. Una lástima que se llegara a esto.
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#143.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#145.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#145.dst: ¡Maravilloso! ¡Ayudante, vas muy bien! ¡Estamos más cerca que nunca de desvelar el misterio de Fruma!
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#147.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#148.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#148.dst: Los saludos, para luego. ¿Tasim? ¿Qué haces aquí? ¿Dónde está Caid?
Recover the Past#148.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#149.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#149.dst: El almirante me envió a reforzar las defensas de {p}. Esperaba verte en el puente, pero solo encontré a Caid.
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#150.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#150.dst: Dijo que se reunía un ataque contra {p} y que tú estabas aquí, y luego salió corriendo.
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#151.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#151.dst: ¡Maldito ladrón! Sabía que no debía marcharme... Todo esto ha sido un error... Maldita sea.
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#152.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#152.dst: No hay tiempo que perder. Vamos, Tasim y {u}. Tenemos que salvar {p}.
Recover the Past#152.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#153.dst: Ese Tasim, ¿será también de Fruma? Si es compañero tuyo, deberías reclutarlo para nuestro pequeño experimento. ¡Por la ciencia, claro! Venga, venga, largo. ¡{p} necesita ayuda!
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#154.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#154.dst: Corre a defender {p} de la incursión en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#155.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#155.dst: ¡Ayudante! ¿Qué haces aquí todavía? ¡Parece que tus amigos necesitan tu ayuda!
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#156.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#156.dst: ¡Además, quizá sea la ocasión de reclutar a ese Tasim para nuestro experimento! Hm, sí, ¡sería sin duda un espécimen interesante!
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#157.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#157.dst: Vendrán a por este puente en cualquier momento. Habrá que estar listos.
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#159.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#159.dst: Buena respuesta, soldado. ¡Los derribaremos, por muchos que nos lancen!
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#160.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#160.dst: Haz antes lo que tengas que hacer, pero rápido. El enemigo puede llegar en cualquier momento.
Recover the Past#160.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#162.dst: Tasim, ponte delante, yo cubro desde atrás.
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#163.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#164.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#164.dst: Ya no debería faltar mucho... Si Aledar estuviera aquí, sería como en los viejos tiempos. ¿No crees?
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#165.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#165.dst: ¡Tengo el objetivo a la vista! ¡Fuerzas corruptas acercándose!
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#167.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#167.dst: Maldita sea. ¡El líder parece escudado! ¿Cómo lo derribamos?
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#168.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#168.dst: ¡Los pinchos deben ser su punto débil!
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#169.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#169.dst: ¡Tienes razón! Tasim, {u}. Mientras mantengáis al enemigo lejos de mí, podré apuntar bien a los pinchos. Es nuestra única oportunidad de derribar a esta cosa.
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#170.dst: ... Ah. Resulta que esto va a ser algo más duro de lo esperado. ¡Pero demos todo lo que tenemos!
Recover the Past#170.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#171.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#171.dst: Solo... un poco más... a la derecha...
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#172.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#172.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#173.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#173.dst: ¡Reynauld! ¿Y ahora qué? Así no podemos vencerlo...
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#174.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#174.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#175.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#175.dst: Tasim, {u}, seguid conteniéndolos. Ya se me ocurrirá algo, lo que sea...
Recover the Past#175.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#176.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#176.dst: ¡No podemos rendirnos ahora, no mientras {p} siga en peligro!
Recover the Past#176.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#177.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#177.dst: ¡Reynauld, no funciona! No dejan de venir... tenemos que hacer otra cosa, ¡o no aguantaremos!
Recover the Past#177.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#178.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#178.dst: Tienes razón. Tendremos que retirarnos y pedir ayuda a {p}. ¡Tres hombres solos no pueden con esto!
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#181.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#181.dst: ¡¿Caid, qué haces aquí?! ¡Es demasiado peligroso, deja esto a los profesionales!
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#182.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#182.dst: ¡Se acabó, se acabó dejar que mi futuro se me escape de las manos!
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#183.dst: ¡Caid, no! No... no puedes, te vas a
Recover the Past#183.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#186.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#186.dst: ¡Ahora, Reynauld! ¡Dispara! ¡Por el amor de Dios, dispara! ¡Está distraído!
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#187.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#188.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#192.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#193.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#193.dst: Todo eso está muy bien pero, ¿y tu barca?
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#194.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#195.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#195.dst: Ja. Pero esta vez no con mis cosas.
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#196.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#196.dst: Bueno, Caid parece bastante entero, dadas las circunstancias. Lo llevaré a que lo revisen, por si acaso. Gracias por vuestra ayuda, Tasim y {u}. Y a Caid también...
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#197.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#197.dst: Supongo que querrás llevarte a Tasim para tu experimento. Después de todo lo que has hecho hoy, poco puedo objetar. Pero, Tasim...
Recover the Past#197.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#198.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#198.dst: Piénsalo bien antes de mirar ese cristal. Para algunos, el pasado está lleno de cosas que preferirían olvidar.
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#199.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... I guess that's something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#199.dst: Recuperar recuerdos de Fruma, eh... Supongo que es algo que me interesaría. He tenido una sensación extraña desde que nos dimos cuenta de que los habíamos perdido.
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#200.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#200.dst: Tú estabas allí, ¿recuerdas? Acabábamos de entrar en Wynn y... Aledar venía con nosotros, ¡y casi se muere el primer día! Espero que ahí fuera tenga más cuidado...
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#201.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#201.dst: Bueno, en fin. Por favor, guíame hasta el doctor. Me intriga saber de qué va todo esto.
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#202.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#202.dst: Lleva a Tasim ante el Dr. Picard en su torre, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#204.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#204.dst: ... Oh, {u}, ¡veo que traes otro sujeto! Excelente, excelente. Acércate a la esfera.
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#205.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#205.dst: Bueno, doctor. ¿Seguro que esto es seguro? Reynauld me advirtió de que
Recover the Past#205.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#206.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#206.dst: Oh, sí, sí. Ya lo hemos probado con dos sujetos, ¿verdad, {u}? ¡Además, he hecho los cálculos! ¡Todos salen bien!
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#207.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#207.dst: Solo hay una minúscula inestabilidad. Hmpf. Quizá solo necesite más potencia... Si aumento el maná que puedo verter en el hechizo, entonces
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#208.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#208.dst: Un momento. ¿Quiere meterle más magia, si ya es inestable?
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#209.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#209.dst: ¿No quieres saber cómo era tu vida antes? Aunque no sea lo que quieres ver, ¿no es mejor saberlo?
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#210.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#210.dst: Está bien. Podemos mirar mis recuerdos. No sé si estoy del todo de acuerdo... pero lo haré.
Recover the Past#210.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#211.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#211.dst: ¡Excelente, me alegra oírlo! Y ahora. Activando en tres... dos... uno... ¡ya!
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#212.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#214.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#214.dst: Grr... No puede haber ido lejos. ¡Registrad la ciudad entera! ¡Que no quede un rincón! ¡Que no escape!
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#215.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#215.dst: Yo- oh, esto va mal... ¿Qué puedo...
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#216.src: ... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#216.dst: ... Maldita sea. Maldito todo. No puedo dejar que se desangre, aunque sea-...
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: ... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.
Recover the Past#217.dst: ... No deberías haberte metido en esto, ¿sabes?

Recover the Past#218.src: Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
Recover the Past#218.dst: Además, ya hemos usado el hechizo en dos sujetos, y a los dos les fue perfectamente... eh, en su mayor parte. Solo hay una levísima inestabilidad.

Recover the Past#219.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#219.dst: ...Maldita sea. Maldito todo. No dejaré que se desangre, aunque sea...
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#221.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#221.dst: Tranquilo, te pondrás bien... Sé qué hacer, aunque no debería...
Recover the Past#221.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#222.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get

Recover the Past#224.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#224.dst: ¡Está aquí dentro! ¡Y tiene un cómplice! ¡Detenedlos a los dos!
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#225.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#225.dst: A mi magia le cuesta mantener el agarre... ¡pero está claro que queda más por ver! Aumentando la potencia...
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#226.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#226.dst: ¿Y qué? ¿Debía haber dejado que te desangraras en mi casa? No seas ridículo.
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#227.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#227.dst: ¡Sí! ¡Deberías! Porque ahora no solo me han detenido por crímenes contra la Corona, sino que a ti te han señalado como uno de los malditos. Nada de esto habría pasado si te hubieras... quedado al margen.
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#228.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#228.dst: ...Era lo correcto. No podía quedarme al margen cuando podía hacer algo por ayudar.
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#229.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#229.dst: Ya, y mira de cuánto nos ha servido. Sabes que de aquí no sale nadie, ¿verdad? ¡Cuando te llevan, nunca se vuelve a saber de ti! Así estamos.
Recover the Past#229.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#231.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#232.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#232.dst: Suerte ahí fuera, Tasim. La vas a necesitar.
Recover the Past#232.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#233.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#233.dst: Nos vemos al otro lado, Aledar.
Recover the Past#233.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#234.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#234.dst: Ejem. Estamos listos para el proceso. Preparad el Ajustador.
Recover the Past#234.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#235.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#236.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#236.dst: Silencio. Antes de empezar, quiero dejar una cosa clara. No necesitamos a los de tu clase en Fruma. No queremos a los de tu clase en Fruma.
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#237.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#237.dst: Lo que haremos hoy contigo es una bondad, una misericordia. Si el mundo se saliera con la suya, estarías mucho peor. Recuérdalo mientras seguimos.
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#239.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#239.dst: Eres un recluta nuevo, enviado a la Provincia de Wynn a luchar en su guerra. Te alistaste porque creías que tus... talentos únicos serían útiles.
Recover the Past#239.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#240.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#240.dst: Fruma no es más que una mota en tu historia. Un hecho grabado en piedra, con los detalles perdidos en un pasado hipotético. La recuerdas con cariño, pero no recuerdas nada.
Recover the Past#240.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#241.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#241.dst: Lucharás en su guerra. Vivirás por ella, morirás por ella. Serás de Wynn para siempre, y Fruma se alegrará de deshacerse de ti.
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#244.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#245.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#245.dst: Preguntaré una vez más. ¿Has entendido tu directriz?
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#247.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#247.dst: Maravilloso. Llevad a este a la caravana. Parece que aún caben dos más en la tanda de hoy.
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#252.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#252.dst: ¡Ayudante! ¡Espabila! ¡Has entrado demasiado hondo, el recuerdo te está absorbiendo!
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#253.dst: Madre mía- ¡ahí estás! ¡¿Entiendes lo peligroso que ha sido eso?!
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#254.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#254.dst: ¡¿Qué me pasa a mí si un ayudante se queda atrapado en sus recuerdos para siempre?! ¡Nada bueno!
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#255.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#255.dst: ... Vale, vale. Nos ha dado más información. ¡Pero no vuelvas a hacerlo! Venga, ven aquí, tenemos mucho de que hablar.
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#256.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#256.dst: ... Hmpf. Lo admito, no... no sé muy bien qué hacer con esta información.
Recover the Past#256.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#257.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#257.dst: La esfera de restaurificación de memoria funcionó todo lo bien que cabía esperar de un solo uso... pero, madre mía, qué duro fue de ver.
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#258.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#258.dst: Es lógico pensar que Caid y Reynauld pasaron por lo mismo... y mi magia no pudo atravesar ese muro...
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#259.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#259.dst: ¿Es esto lo que hacen allí, en Fruma, con sus criminales? ¿Expulsarlos a luchar en la guerra de Wynn?
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#260.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#260.dst: ... Tendré que pensar cuánto quiero ahondar en los recuerdos. ¡En todo caso! Al principio de todo te prometí que podríamos ver los tuyos.
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#261.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#261.dst: La oferta sigue en pie, si quieres aceptarla. Solo tienes que acercarte a la esfera, como los demás.
Recover the Past#261.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#262.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#262.dst: ¿Y bien? La oferta sigue en pie, si quieres aceptarla. Simplemente acércate a la esfera, igual que los demás.
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#263.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#264.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#264.dst: ... Ah, qué más da. Tengo los planos guardados por aquí. Siempre puedo hacer otra... pero aun así.
Recover the Past#264.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#266.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#266.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Ah, sí! ¡Perdona, se me olvidó por completo preguntarte! ¿Estás bien?
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#267.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#267.dst: Ninguno de los otros sujetos tuvo una reacción tan fuerte... qué raro. Es casi como si accediéramos a recuerdos que no existían.
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#268.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#268.dst: ... Bueno. Ejem. En cualquier caso, tendré que seguir investigando. Seguro que queda mucho por aprender...
Recover the Past#268.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#269.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#269.dst: En agradecimiento por tu ayuda. Toma, una recompensa. Ah, además... creo que tu amigo está justo fuera de la torre. Quizá quieras ver cómo está.
Recover the Past#269.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#270.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#270.dst: Encuentra a Tasim fuera de la torre del Dr. Picard, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#272.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#272.dst: Maldito. Me ha llamado maldito. ¿Qué significa eso para mí...?
Recover the Past#272.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#273.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#273.dst: Y el Inquisidor... No sé qué pensar. Todos nosotros lo que creíamos saber al llegar a Wynn... Nada de ello era cierto.
Recover the Past#273.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#274.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#274.dst: ... ¿De verdad nos conocimos por pura casualidad? Él huía de algo y... cayó de lleno en mi vida.
Recover the Past#274.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#275.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#275.dst: Yo- necesito espacio para pensar. Para... reflexionar. ¿Puedes... por favor, no le cuentes nada de esto a Aledar.
Recover the Past#275.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#276.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#276.dst: No necesita saber todo esto. Es- es mejor que no lo sepa.
Recover the Past#276.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#277.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#277.dst: ... Creo que me iré a la Provincia de Gavel. Está al otro lado del océano, lo bastante lejos de... De todo esto.
Recover the Past#277.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#278.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#278.dst: Cuando te hagas más fuerte, deberías ir tú también. Quizá acabemos encontrándonos.
Recover the Past#278.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#279.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#279.dst: Supongo que esto es un adiós, por ahora. No para siempre, solo por ahora. Nos vemos, {u}.
Recover the Past#279.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#280.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#280.dst: ... Solo estoy descansando un poco aquí. Pronto me pondré en camino.
Recover the Past#280.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#281.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...
Recover the Past#281.dst: Es la caja de la que hablaba Caid...
